anatomy.demo: 平台入口→函数实例→外部状态
anatomy.demo_en: API gateway→Function instance→External status

parts.desc: 平台负责网址、HTTPS、扩缩容和请求分发
parts.desc_en: The platform handles URLs, HTTPS, scaling, and request routing.

parts.desc: 你的代码只在请求或事件到来时执行
parts.desc_en: Your code runs when a request or event arrives.

parts.desc: 持久数据放数据库或存储服务，不依赖函数内存
parts.desc_en: Persistent state lives in databases or storage, not function memory.

use.t: 小型网站的 API、表单提交、支付回调和定时任务
希望跟随前端一起部署，不想先维护 VPS
把每个函数设计成短小、无状态、可重复执行
在平台设置中配置 {c:env-var}，不要写进仓库

dont.t: 不要把长时间转码或永久连接直接放进短时函数
依赖函数内存保存状态：后续请求可能由不同实例处理
忽略超时、区域、并发和计费限制
把平台绑定写满业务每一层，未来难以迁移

lessonPractice.title: 小官网只有联系表单：收到提交后保存内容并发通知，不想维护服务器。哪种方案更合适？

options.label: 使用短时 Serverless 函数，把数据保存到外部服务并配置超时与密钥
options.feedback: 任务按请求触发且时间短，平台可托管运行环境；持久数据和密钥仍需使用合适服务。

options.label: 把每次表单内容保存在函数内存里，之后请求继续读取
options.feedback: 不同请求可能落到不同实例，实例也会释放，函数内存不能当作持久数据库。

options.label: 让一次函数调用持续运行几小时，顺便处理视频转码
options.feedback: 短时函数受执行时长和资源限制，长任务需要匹配的队列或计算服务。

en.title: A small site only needs a contact form that saves submissions and sends notifications, without server maintenance. Which approach fits?

options.label: Use a short serverless function, persist data externally, and configure timeouts and secrets
options.feedback: The task is brief and request-driven, so the platform can manage runtime while persistence and secrets use appropriate services.

options.label: Store form submissions in function memory and read them from later requests
options.feedback: Requests may reach different instances and instances disappear, so function memory is not durable storage.

options.label: Keep one invocation running for hours and use it for video transcoding too
options.feedback: Short functions have duration and resource limits; long jobs require suitable queues or compute services.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请用短时无状态 Serverless 函数处理联系表单，校验输入后写入外部存储并发送通知。密钥放平台环境变量，处理重复提交、超时和失败重试；不要依赖函数内存保存长期状态。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Handle the contact form with a short stateless serverless function that validates input, writes to external storage, and sends a notification. Keep secrets in platform environment variables and handle duplicates, timeouts, and retries without relying on function memory.

scenes: 每天运行一次定时任务

dont.t: Keep important state only in function memory
Run a long job beyond the platform limit
Assume there is no infrastructure or cost to manage
Split a simple workflow into too many tiny functions

环境变量AI_API_KEY = ••••••••Git 仓库不包含密钥

usageMocks.sl-dont-memory:
下一次请求可能换实例

需要保留的数据应该写入数据库或缓存

超时10s区域sin1并发100本月调用82%
